context: Saito gives a routine check for Aoi's child.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: あおいさん、お子さん、健康、いかが？
lines.en: Aoi-san, how is your child doing health-wise?
lines.style: Warm opening with genuine professional care. Soft, clear diction. Unhurried pace. A doctor who has asked this question a hundred times but means it each time.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Thank you — she's doing very well.
lines.style: Grateful warmth rising to the surface. Voice brightens slightly. Relief audible but not performed. The ease of someone sharing good news with a person she trusts.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.style: Steady, affirming tone. A gentle emphasis on the positive news. Measured pace that lets the words land. The reassurance of professional confidence delivered as a gift.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Ah, I'm so relieved to hear that.
lines.style: Breath released on the opening word. Warmth flooding back. Shoulders settling. A mother hearing exactly what she needed to hear.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: Please come back anytime you have questions — I'm always here.
lines.style: Steady, open-ended warmth. A promise underneath the formality. No rush in the pacing. The door left open, genuinely.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 一緒に、見守って、本当に、感謝。
lines.en: Watching over her together — I really can't thank you enough.
lines.style: Deep gratitude trembling just beneath the surface. Unhurried, sincere. A slight catch of emotion held in check. The voice of someone who knows what good care means.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: Your child is precious — may she stay healthy and strong.
lines.style: Closing warmth with quiet tenderness. Each word given weight. Slower pace at the end. The benediction of a doctor who sees the person, not just the patient.
